# mapx Docs

> Maps, search, navigation, elevation, transit, traffic and static images for Austria, from official open data. Free API token.

- [Transit API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/transit/): Journeys with public transport (on foot or by bike to the stop), departure boards and stops, based …
- [Static Images API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/static-images/): Renders a map image for a view and size, optionally with overlays. The result is cacheable (ETag). …
- [Tilequery and Parcel API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/tilequery/): Tilequery returns the vector features near a coordinate. Parcel returns the cadastral parcel (area, …
- [Elevation API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/elevation/): Height above sea level (m) for points or along a line, from the terrain model (dtm) or the surface …
- [Weather API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/weather/): Observations of the nearest stations, an hourly forecast for a point and raster tiles for a map …
- [Air Quality API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/air-quality/): Daily air quality index and hourly nitrogen dioxide, ozone, PM10 and PM2.5 near the surface plus …
- [Climate API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/climate/): Climate of a point: yearly solar radiation and sunshine hours, temperature and precipitation …
- [Traffic API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/traffic/): Incident reports (accidents, roadworks, closures), speed limits shown on motorway gantries and a …
- [Errors and limits](https://docs.mapx.at/api/errors/): Every error is an application/problem+json document (RFC 9457). The type is a URI into this page: …

- [DSM surface model](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/dsm/): The DSM is the counterpart to the DTM: it shows the surface including buildings, trees and bridges. …
- [Orthophoto](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/orthophoto/): The BEV orthophoto, re-tiled in Web Mercator up to z18 (20 cm, the native resolution of the source). …
- [Sentinel-2 current](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/sentinel2/): A satellite image of Austria that updates every day: each pixel shows a robust value from the most …
- [Flight blocks](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/orthophoto-flight-blocks/): For each pixel of the orthophoto, the area of the survey flight (operat) it comes from, with flight …
